scope: Offline staged source only; original source and operator hold untouched.

tests.scope: resource guards, full-chip, capture overlap, acquisition budgets
injected coverage failure, STOP/resume, completed full-chip and lease regression

limitations: RAM preflight cannot control concurrent allocations or guarantee no memory failure.
Disk device failure can prevent even a terminal JSON write; no successful persistence claim is made then.
Focus/time limits remain cooperative across finite vendor RPC timeouts.
Two exceptional local-focus attempts default per chip; explicit options can increase up to100.
Host lock canonicalizes loopback names and acquires legacy checkout ancestor locks; external non-FlakeFinder clients are not covered.
